subject: USE statement
notes: kb/Work PB370 (w1107a): CONFORMS, two gaps in the PB3261 order closed. Re-probed on the merged build, conformance:cases/14.9.25-MOVE/pb370_move_first_condition failed three legs on PB3261's mechanism: MOVE N(I) TO O(1) and MOVE O(1) TO N(I) over an occurs-depending O raised the receiver's condition first, because the literal subscript's 13.18.38.4 GR7 bound test rides the table step (FixedTableSegment.Odo) and PlaceIdentification.IdentifiesAtRunTime answered 'nothing' for it (it now counts that test and an OCCURS DYNAMIC element); and MOVE X(1:L) TO T(FUNCTION SQRT(NEG)) raised the receiver subscript's EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION first, because a function-bearing subscript is a pre-op that runs before the statement whatever the store's order (MoveBinder.BindMoveOf now freezes the sender at N = 1 when the receiver registered a pre-op and the sender identifies at run time, placed before those pre-ops by SendingValueTemp.Positioned). The golden's nine MOVE legs (EC-BOUND-REF-MOD, -SUBSCRIPT, -ODO, EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION, a BASED operand's EC-DATA-PTR-NULL, both orders) and the nonfatal-first EVALUATE leg now pass. || kb/Work PB3261 LANDED (w1102g): CONFORMS. The PB370 re-probe's fatal-fatal shape is fixed at its root: a store renders as <receiver> = <value> and C# evaluates the receiver's address first, so MOVE X(1:L) TO T(I) range-tested the receiving subscript (EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT) before the sending reference modifier (EC-BOUND-REF-MOD), against §14.9.25.4 GR1's sender-first order. PlaceIdentification.SenderFirst now evaluates the sending value into a block-scoped local before the receiver's address whenever both sides identify at run time; every MoveEmitter store arm renders through it (INITIALIZE keeps the receiver first, §14.6.4 7), ImplicitMovePhrase.ReceiverIdentifiedFirst), and so do the pointer-family SET stores (§14.9.39.4 GR12, GR14, GR16). Siblings fixed on the same root: the arithmetic statements materialize the initial evaluation for one receiver that identifies at run time (§14.7.7 rule 4; ADD FUNCTION NUMVAL(X(1:L)) TO N(I) read N(I) first, and COMPUTE / GIVING did too without EC-SIZE checking), and STRING reads each sending operand and delimiter in statement order before identifier-3 (§14.6.4 7); STRING X(1:L) DELIMITED SIZE INTO T(I) raised EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT). Spec-derived witness conformance:cases/14.9.49-USE/pb3261_sender_first_order: thirteen statements failing on both sides (five MOVE shapes in both directions, four arithmetic forms, two STRING positions, INITIALIZE's receiver-first order) plus the nonfatal-first EVALUATE shape (EC-RANGE-INVALID's declarative runs before the later EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT one), and in-range value legs. EDITIONS: the observable rides the 2002 exception-condition facility (>>TURN, USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION); the evaluation order itself is edition-invariant.
